Pinus_maximartinezii_cone_Huazamota_Dura.titulo: File:Pinus maximartinezii cone, Huazamota, Durango, Mexico 1.jpg
Pinus_maximartinezii_cone_Huazamota_Dura.desc: Pinus maximartinezii cone, Sierras de Huazamota area, Durango, Mexico. Obtained in the market at Mezquital, where the indigenous Tepehuanos extracted the pine nuts. They mentioned the cone as coming from the mountains of Huazamota. Mapped location is for the known population about 25 km NE of Huazam
